description: This file is a shell script responsible for bundling and managing dependencies for the A2UI component within a larger project. It performs tasks such as checking for source files, computing hashes for cache validation, and invoking build tools like tsc and rolldown to generate the bundled JavaScript file.

methods.name: on_error
methods.description: Handles errors during the bundling process by outputting an error message to stderr.

methods.name: compute_hash
methods.description: Calculates a hash based on project files to determine if rebundling is necessary.
